scripts.db:link: node scripts/with-env.mjs SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD -- sh -c 'supabase link --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"'
scripts.db:push: node scripts/with-env.mjs SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD -- supabase db push && node scripts/verify-db-security.mjs
scripts.worker:test: npm --prefix worker test && npm --prefix worker run check
scripts.worker:deploy: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_INBOX_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler deploy
scripts.worker:secret: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_INBOX_API_TOKEN ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -- sh -c 'printf %s "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | npx wrangler secret put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'
scripts.worker:cert: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_INBOX_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler cert upload certificate-authority --ca-cert ../supabase/ca.crt --name supabase-root
scripts.worker:tail: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_INBOX_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler tail
scripts.files:bucket: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_FILES_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler r2 bucket create attachments
scripts.files:deploy: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_FILES_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.files.jsonc
scripts.files:tail: cd worker && node ../scripts/with-env.mjs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=CLOUDFLARE_FILES_API_TOKEN -- npx wrangler tail -c wrangler.files.jsonc
